title: Certified Improvements to Best-Known Thomson-Problem Configurations with a Search Pipeline Built with Large Language Model Agents
summary: The agent-built search found lower-energy strict local minima for Thomson configurations at N=912, 1382 and 2502; exact-integer certificates and a separate verification implementation checked local minima.
